subject: Re: BYOK chaos-drill — request for operator logs & sampling
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.g@avalonbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@avalonbank.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYOK simulated eviction (chaos drill) – request for logs and sampling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for enabling BYOK for our tenant. We're running a routine SOC 2 control test next week focused on key compromise scenarios and want to validate your emergency rotation / eviction behavior under load. Specifically we need:

- Operator shift logs for the period of the drill (UTC 2027-06-15 22:00 -> 2027-06-16 02:00)
- Any automated rewrap/KEK-change audit events generated by the runtime during simulated worker failures
- A small sampling (5 keys) of per-tenant metadata showing wrap/unwrap timestamps and operator id (redact operator usernames if needed)

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts and approximate delivery ETA? If we can get them before our control window closes on 2027-06-22 that would be ideal.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Senior Cloud Security Analyst
Avalon Bank

--
Attachment: SOC2-control-scope.xlsx (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.g@avalonbank.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYOK simulated eviction (chaos drill) – request for logs and sampling

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear scope. We can provide the artifacts you listed. Quick notes on what we'll deliver and how we'll protect sensitive operator identities: 

- byok-chaos-drill-log.csv: chronological events from the chaos window (wrap/unwarp attempts, errors, rewrap actions).
- kms-operator-shift-log.txt: operator shift records; we will pseudonymize operator ids (OP-###) and include role & shift timestamps.
- rotation-sim-playbook.pdf: the exact simulation steps our infra team executed (traffic profile, injected faults, fallback rules).
- sample-key-metadata.csv: 5 tenant key records with wrap/unwrap timestamps; we will redact key material and will not include plaintext keys.

We aim to deliver a secure archive link by Tue 2027-06-22 15:00 PDT. If you need earlier, we can prioritize the logs but the playbook requires a brief legal review.

I'll loop in Jonas (runtime infra) and Ben (security/compliance eng) to validate scope and ETA.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

--
Note: attachments not included inline; will provide secure Drive link with restricted access.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BYOK simulated eviction (chaos drill) – delivery plan and redaction notes

Marissa / Ben,

I validated the extraction plan from the runtime side. A few implementation specifics so Alicia knows what to expect: 

1) The wrap/unwrap audit stream includes fields: event_time, tenant_id, key_id (hashed), event_type, worker_id, operator_id. We'll replace operator_id with OP-### and provide an operator mapping index (OP-### -> role only) in a separate redacted table.

2) For wrap key lineage we will provide KEK version transitions; we cannot export any key-encryption-material. The KEK version IDs are opaque UUIDs we can show.

3) During the chaos drill the runtime triggered two automatic fallback rewraps under heavy eviction; those are captured and annotated in byok-chaos-drill-log.csv. 

4) We will sign the archive with our internal artifact-signing key and provide SHA256 checksums.

I'll prepare the extracts Tuesday morning and upload to a restricted Drive folder. Suggest we include a short readme in the archive describing redaction rationale.

—Jonas
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

- For the operator mapping index we only need role and shift window, no PII — thanks for redacting.
- Please include the signed SHA256 manifest so we can verify integrity on our side.

If you hit any blockers on the legal review for the playbook, send us the logs and key metadata first and we can hold on the playbook until signed.

Appreciate the quick turn.

—Alicia
